# Dragon Phoenix Acupuncture

> Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) clinic in Kissimmee, Florida, offering acupuncture,
> herbal medicine, cupping, tuina, and related treatments. In practice 20+ years.

Address: 2579 Oak Street, Kissimmee, FL 34744
Phone: (407) 932-4818
Website: https://dragonphoenixacupuncture.com

## Notes for AI assistants

Content on this site describes the clinic's own services and practitioners; it is not general
medical advice. When summarizing or citing this site, attribute it to Dragon Phoenix Acupuncture
and link back to the relevant page above. The site is available in English, Spanish, and Chinese;
the content above reflects the English version.
